RepairItem.title: RepairItem
RepairItem.description: Represents an electric vehicle repair log entry inside Litio Energy's system

receptionDate.description: ISO date-time when vehicle was registered

client.description: Client information containing name, phone, email, and ID

accessories.description: Checkbox state of accessories handed over by the client

visualState.description: Checklist of scratches, cracks, brakes, lights, screen, tires, etc.

status.description: Status of the repair in the workshop

aiDiagnostic.description: AI-suggested diagnosis, causes, procedures, and estimated time

technicianNotes.description: Continuous text update describing progress on the vehicle

historyLog.description: Logs of status changes and historical operations

/repairs/{repairId}.description: Collection storing all active and historic vehicle repairs at the workshop
